title: Signature Duo 28 · Hourglass SSBBW × USSBBW · Gamji Geumni × Irezumi Waves · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, two enormous women contrasting a deep hourglass waist with no waist at all.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — early 40s, sleek low bun with a gold binyeo. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body. Body Art: Full body Korean gamji geumni painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A deep indigo-blue ground like dyed indigo paper, not purple, painted in fine shimmering gold ink with continuous lotus scrolls and cloud patterns, purely ornamental, no religious figures. The gold lotus scrolls spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — late 30s, sleek high bun with red lacquer kanzashi. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white ground of continuous curling white-crested waves with vermilion and gold wind bars and scattered cherry petals. The waves cover the whole body, each belly roll carrying its own curling white-crested wave, darker pigment settling into each deep crease. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing full frontal in a wide stance, arms relaxed slightly away from the body. The right woman — standing full frontal in a relaxed contrapposto with her feet planted apart, her weight on one leg so that huge hip juts outward, arms held away from the body, never covering the belly.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high deep indigo lacquer platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft warm light from one side carving the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips on the left and deep shadows between each belly roll on the right, making the materials gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
